source_documents.title: Lomustine medac40mg capsules common SmPC
source_documents.role: Manufacturer primary source explicitly linked by NCCP; current revision postdates NCCP2024. Supplied unlicensed product and pharmacy applicability require confirmation.

validation.interpretation: Before failing cases include newly added domains and schedule/provenance checks; they are not a distinct clinical-defect count.

findings.title: Unsupported DLCO stop threshold
findings.before: Original assessment automatically withheld atDLCO<60%, without support in NCCP00805.
findings.after: Remove the invented cutoff. Current SmPC FVC/DLCO<70% is a pulmonary-risk review flag; new respiratory symptoms still prompt urgent safety review.

findings.title: Platelet gap incomplete
findings.before: Original80–99 inclusive warning missed values99.1–99.999 and did not distinguish recovery from a documented delay.
findings.after: Cover80–<100 fully as an explicit source gap; prior delay continues to require recovery to≥100. RetainANC<1/<80 delay and≥1/≥100 minimum source row.

findings.title: Severe hepatic impairment unassessed
findings.before: No hepatic impairment field or rule existed.
findings.after: Add mild/moderate no-adjustment-expected and severe not-recommended pathways without fabricated ALT/bilirubin thresholds.

findings.title: Not-recommended vs formal contraindication conflated
findings.before: The prior numeric renal rule labelledCrCl<30/dialysis as contraindicated.
findings.after: Preserve NCCP not-recommended wording with an administration hold; separately encode the product formal severe-renal-impairment contraindication. Review30–50 original-dose75% against dose history rather than automatically multiplying the current dose.

findings.title: Missing minimum interval and exposure limits
findings.before: No executable repeat-interval, course cap, dose-intensity or cumulative exposure check.
findings.after: Structured single-doseDay1q42 schedule;280mg cap; proposed>130mg/m², repeat<42days and projected>1000mg/m² restrictions. Existing≥1000mg/m² prevents further courses. Missing exposure is not zero.

findings.title: Delayed nadirs not assessed
findings.after: Add priorWBC/platelet nadirs with source-labelled review; distinguishANCfromWBC, retain prior reductions, flag current SmPC repeat-doseWBC≥4 requirement. No automatic percentage from discordant/overlapping table rows.

findings.title: Product nadir-table overlap
findings.before: Current SmPC70% platelet row starts at24,000/mm³, overlapping50% row below25,000.
findings.after: Explicit24–<25×10⁹/L overlap warning; all nadir percentages require consultant/pharmacy reconciliation.

findings.title: Nonhaematological reduction/restoration history missing
findings.before: A single active Grade≥3 rule included reduction and possible later restoration without verifying recovery, recurrence, dose history or42days.
findings.after: Separate active hold, history, baseline recovery, clinical relevance, already-applied reduction and42-day nonrecurrence review; no calculated50% or full-dose restoration.

findings.title: Missing product contraindications
findings.before: No direct flags for other nitrosourea allergy/nonresponse, severe marrow depression, product-specific wheat allergy or live vaccines.
findings.after: Add source-labelled exclusions, including careful distinction of wheat allergy from coeliac disease and supplier-specific product excipients.

findings.title: Monitoring lacked source separation
findings.before: No explicit weeklyCBC≥6weeks or PFT source difference.
findings.after: NCCP baseline/regularFBCrenalLFT retained; current SmPC weeklyCBC for at least six weeks and baseline/frequentPFTs explicit. NCCP PFTs remain described as conditional high-risk testing; individualMRI plan retained.

findings.title: Contraception advice outdated relative to supplied product reference
findings.before: NCCP says6months for both men/women; January2026 common SmPC says7women/4men.
findings.after: Both positions clearly identified for pharmacy/product confirmation; do not silently shorten existing advice or claim a common universal duration.

findings.title: Alkylator history, interactions and overdose guards missing
findings.before: No explicit prior-alkylator/marrow-reserve, antiseizure interaction or extra-dose pathways.
findings.after: Add consultant review for prior alkylation, compromised reserve and interacting medicines; urgent assessment for potential extra dosing, emphasising delayed toxicity.

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP assigns no dose to platelets 80–<100 with ANC ≥1.0. Flag specialist review across the entire fractional interval. A previous hold requires recovery to platelets≥100.

sources.document: Lomustine medac SmPC January 2026; revised 16 January 2026

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP uses ANC ≥1.0 and platelets≥100; the product SmPC requires WBC ≥4.0 and platelets≥100 before repeat dosing. WBC is not ANC. Resolve any mismatch before a further course.

sources.document: Lomustine medac SmPC January 2026; revised 16 January 2026

source_conflicts.resolution: The SmPC 70% row starts at platelets 24,000/mm³, overlapping its 50% row below 25,000/mm³. Values 24–<25×10⁹/L and discordant WBC/platelet rows need source clarification; no definitive percentage is calculated.

sources.document: Lomustine medac SmPC January 2026; revised 16 January 2026

source_conflicts.resolution: Renal 75% refers to the original dose; SmPC nadir 70/50% refers to prior dose; non-haematological reduction 50% and subsequent full-dose restoration require clinical interpretation. Do not multiply percentages or erase prior reductions.

sources.document: Lomustine medac SmPC January 2026; revised 16 January 2026

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP makes PFTs conditional on high risk, whereas the product SmPC requests baseline and frequent ongoing PFTs. Retain both labelled recommendations and confirm local plan. FVC/DLCO <70% is a risk signal, not an automatic DLCO <60% withholding threshold.

sources.document: Lomustine medac SmPC January 2026; revised 16 January 2026

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP says six months for men and women; January 2026 product SmPC says seven months for women and four months for men. Confirm product-specific pharmacy advice; do not publish an unqualified shared duration or silently shorten existing advice.

limitations: Independent clinical/pharmacy review pending; no clinical-use approval.
Staged-only candidate; main checkout not changed by this task. Full-suite patient/PDF/browser/release integration is separate.

Cumulative proposed total is an explicitly verified clinician-entered value, not an automated addition. The derived difference rejects non-increasing totals and cannot be forged by supplying a delta. Verify actual exposure and proposed dose with pharmacy.
All numerical dose modification calculations blocked due to source denominators, recovery/history and product differences; reference percentages remain visible with attribution.
Manufacturer common SmPC is the primary product document linked by NCCP; confirm the actual imported/unlicensed product and local pharmacy instructions.
